_note: The WORLD's rules. Code (not the AI) uses this to update needs, check moves and apply results. Try changing numbers and see what happens.

needs._note: How much each need grows (+) or shrinks (-) per 15-minute tick. 0 = fine, 1 = urgent.

mood._note: Mood drifts toward 'base', pulled down by any need above 'pressing_from'. Each decoration he builds (trees, lamps...) lifts 'base' a little, up to decor_bonus_max.

clock._note: How fast his town runs online. speed 8 = 1 of his days in about 3 real hours (like Pino). Each GitHub run lives whatever is due since the last run, at most max_ticks_per_run (so a long GitHub delay can't make him live a whole day in one go). speed 1 = real time. With the paid AI brain, cost goes up with speed.

bedtime._note: Local time (Florida). Between these hours autopilot sends him home to sleep, no AI calls. He writes his diary when he goes to bed.

town._note: How the town STARTS (24 lots since 2026-11-25; older towns get topped up). Lots are spots along the street (0 = far left). Everything else he builds himself.

mega_mart._note: A massive supermarket at the north end of the island (a gift, opened 2026-11-27; a fixed place, not a lot). go_shopping there + "item":"<id>" buys one thing from the catalogue. Brick coins only. max_per_trip = things per visit; big_per_day = buys of big_from+ coins per day (a world rule for both brains, so the Thailand jar keeps growing). The FREE brain also keeps to budget_share of everything he has earned and always keeps 'reserve' coins (groceries, which SAVE him coins, only need the reserve), and shops mostly in this order: pays -> pup -> comfort -> fun ('whim' = how much he strays from it). The real brain sees 'prompt_items' useful things he can afford.

catalogue._note: Everything on the Mega Mart shelves (go_shopping + "item"). One of each, except 'stock' things (supplies he uses up and buys again: 'stock' = how many uses a pack gives, 'supply' = the cupboard it goes in). What things DO: 'on' = extra effects on a move (needs, 'mult' = that need fixed x times better, mood, coins, bricks, pup, 'pup_mult', 'free' = no coin cost, 'train' = better training odds); 'rates' / 'pup_rates' = his / the pup's needs change x times as fast; 'shield' = heat or cold stops bothering him ('pup_shield' for the pup); 'mood_base' = a small lift all the time; 'sell_chance'; 'product_value' = his things sell for more; 'stage' = fewer bike-restoration sessions; 'no_wait' = skips an overnight wait; 'sessions' = more bike sessions a day; 'unlocks' = a new move. 'needs_item' / 'needs_place' / 'season' = only worth it then (the free brain checks). 'group' = the free brain's shopping order.

weather._cold: At cold_from C or colder (Mega Mart, 2026-11-27): his mood target drops by cold_mood unless he owns a heater; the pup gets tired pup_cold_tired faster per awake tick unless he has a winter coat.

books._note: His reading never runs dry: when the books he can reach (home shelf + the library once it's built) are down to 'refill_below' unread chapters, the next BOOK BOX arrives at his door (max one a day). Boxes are in jarvis/library/books.json (where = box). Box 1 comes with the first barn-find bike. When every box is read he re-reads old favourites.

garage_projects._note: Bike restorations in his garage. A project TURNS UP (free, e.g. a barn find) or is OFFERED for coins (buy_a_project_bike). He works through the stages with work_on_the_restoration (max 'sessions_per_day'); a stage with 'coins' needs parts first (order_restoration_parts), which arrive the NEXT day. 'wait' = after that many sessions he has to leave it till tomorrow (soak, paint drying). The 'start' stage is the first start: 'odds' = chance it fires on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd go (a fail = try again tomorrow). Finished books with project_stage perks cut sessions. When it runs: ride_a_restored_bike, then keep_the_restored_bike or sell_the_restored_bike (at the market stall, coin range 'sell'). The next project turns up 'gap_days' after the garage is free.
